children: Franklin Street Properties reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $24.9 million, down 8.7% from $27.3 million a year earlier, and a net loss of $9.1 million, compared with a $8.3 million loss in the prior-year quarter. Diluted EPS was a loss of $0.09, versus a loss of $0.08.
Revenue was $24.9M, compared with $27.3M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (8.7%).
Net loss was $9.1M, compared with a net loss of $8.3M in the prior-year quarter; the loss widened by $777K.
Diluted EPS was ($0.09), compared with ($0.08) in the prior-year quarter.
Portfolio occupancy was 66.2% at September 30, down from 68.9% at year-end 2025, as lease expirations exceeded new leasing.
The company leased 226,000 square feet during the first nine months, with an average lease term of 6.8 years; new leases averaged 11.5% above property rents.
Franklin Street Properties continued a strategic review with financial advisers and identified asset and subportfolio sale opportunities to pursue in the fourth quarter.

Management is focused on improving occupancy, extending lease duration, controlling operating costs and directing capital toward leasing and property improvements. Nine-month rental revenue declined $3.6 million, primarily because of property sales and lease expirations; management cited larger leasing prospects but noted that market uncertainty could delay activity.
